stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024 entering class): percentages from College Navigator, exact counts (7,583 applied, 3,952 admitted, 505 enrolled) from the NCES file via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal. No current Common Data Set was found: Bard's disclosures page lists CDS files only through 2022-23, so international applicants and admits, waitlist, ED counts, GPA, SAT total and admission factors are not shown. SAT/ACT percentiles cover enrolled first-time students who submitted scores (66 SAT, 46 ACT); Bard has been test-optional for over 50 years. Undergraduate enrollment (2,414) and nonresident (340) are IPEDS fall 2024 degree-seeking undergraduates; the 9 to 1 student-to-faculty ratio is the College Navigator figure.

cost.notes: College Scorecard (data released 2026-10-15; IPEDS charges for 2025-26, which match the 2025-26 cost tables published by Berea, Pitzer and Scripps): tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance.
